metadata.title: Measurement Invariance for Multilingual Learners Using Item Response and Response Time in PISA 2018

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study does not use plausible values as it focuses on measurement invariance using item-fit statistics and response-time functioning.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study uses PISA microdata but does not mention whether sampling weights were applied in the analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study analyzes individual student responses without employing multilevel modeling or accounting for school clustering.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study does not mention any external validation methods and appears to rely solely on internal validation techniques.
